entities.summary: Liam Foudy is a Canadian professional ice hockey centre for the Bridgeport Islanders of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract with the New York Islanders of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected 18th overall by the Columbus Blue Jackets in the 2018 NHL entry draft.
